A final-only witness would freeze the then-current Run too late, so original task/Run/queue binding must be appended in the same transaction as initial control acceptance before its durable response.
recommended_witness_protocol.null_semantics: CHECK full variant shape, typed values and null-safe identities. UNQUEUED_RUN records real original Run/epoch/dispatch plus proof of absent Task client-session/queue generation at admission. NO_RUN records never-dispatched provenance, not empty invented IDs. recommended_witness_protocol.final: Exactly one FINALIZED per ADMITTED member, identical authority fields and membership hash, final response digest shared across complete group. Validate full typed final response and immutable settlement references before insert; SQL trigger checks complete exact group and ordinary canonical facts before the sole ACK journal CAS. quiescence_requirements: Freeze control target membership at initial admission; require no new or moved member/Run replacing original membership during finalization. Parent Goal cancellation must not treat one stopped member as whole-Goal settlement.

Original queued Run: same original Run/epoch/dispatch/process identity; canonical terminal status with children_stopped and queue_empty plus durable cancellation proof including clear/drop, abort_observed and cancelledidle same generation when required by runtime. Real process/job termination facts and original latest effects reconciled; a worker flag or idle alone is insufficient.

Original unqueued Run: preserve actual noqueue variant, require original Run terminal and trusted process/child/effect settlement using its real dispatch. Prove no client queue existed for that original binding, without inventing queue receipts or accepting null generation as evidence. Later created queues/tasks do not rewrite the original admission.

Never-dispatched Task: immutable cancellation/version anchors, zero original Run/dispatch, no unresolved accepted commands, and any actual queue dropped/consumed with sealed watermark and no restore fence. Nonqueue noRun branch has explicit absence proof instead of invented Run/generation.

Latest original MODEL/TOOL effects UNKNOWN/STARTED or pending reconciliation block final. A late exact ACK affects only its original resource effect; it is not SDK/process/queue proof. Cancel finalization releases no reservation or actual_cost, even after process stops.

Atomic read validation inside caller transaction prevents membership/finality snapshot races; SQL constraints recheck body/identity/full group against immutable witnesses. Historical final replay uses frozen references, not mutable heads or later attempts.

Restored pending ACK/queues remain RECONCILING/UNKNOWN and cannot gain FINALIZED proof from restore itself. Finalized pre-restore records are validated against frozen historical snapshots and retained unchanged while current writer credentials/leases are fenced.
